strengths.item: Founder domain expertise in European business schools
strengths.evidence: Alex has 12 direct contacts from prior career in business school administration
No dedicated analytics platform for European business schools currently exists
Each school added increases value for all participants through comparative analytics

weaknesses.evidence: CTO must be hired externally before product development can begin adding 2-3 months to timeline
No pilot data yet — all demand signals are from conversations not signed contracts
Student behavioural data processing requirements not yet assessed could constrain core features

opportunities.evidence: AMBA 2025 standards require documented learning outcome measurement

opportunities.item: EU funding available for EdTech adoption
opportunities.evidence: Digital Education Action Plan 2021-2027 allocates 2B EUR for digital transformation in education
Business schools generate 40% of revenue from exec ed with higher willingness to pay

threats.evidence: Canvas released basic analytics dashboard in 2024 and could continue expanding
Missing the Q4 budget cycle means 12-month delay to next purchase window
EU DPA enforcement actions against EdTech companies increased 40% in 2024

strategic_implications: The business should pursue a land-and-expand strategy leveraging Alex's existing network to secure 3-4 pilot schools rapidly then use pilot data to prove retention improvement claims before scaling sales. The primary risk is timeline — the CTO hire and GDPR assessment must happen in parallel to avoid missing the Q4 2026 budget cycle. The benchmarking network effect is the key long-term moat but only activates after 10+ schools are onboarded.
priority_strategic_issues: Hire CTO within 60 days to begin product development before academic year deadline
Complete GDPR data processing impact assessment before first pilot to avoid compliance blockers
Secure 3 letter-of-intent commitments from business schools to validate demand before full build

assumptions_used.statement: Canvas native analytics will not reach predictive capability within 18 months
assumptions_used.source_detail: Based on Canvas product roadmap analysis

assumptions_used.statement: Network effects activate meaningfully at 10+ schools

uncertainties: Whether schools will participate in cross-institution benchmarking
How quickly Canvas or Moodle could replicate core features
